notes.title: Indie RPG Get In The Car Loser combines its DLC and base game into one
notes.notes:
Fancy a road trip adventure? Stylish indie RPG Get In The Car, Loser is changing the way you buy it, as developer Love Conquers All bundles its base offering and two expansion chapters into a single package to ensure everyone sees "the best parts" of the journey. It's a delightful blend of visual novel-style dialogue and JRPG-inspired combat wrapped in vibrant pixel-art visuals and with a storming soundtrack, and you'll now get the complete experience for one price.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: All DLC now included!
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone for your three and a half years of support since the game's launch! To everyone, whether you downloaded the game when it was free or bought all the DLC when it launched, I'm sincerely grateful for you joining us on Sam's adventure.

In this update, we've upgraded everyone's copies of the game to include both DLC story chapters going forward—I want everyone to get to experience the full story of Get in the Car, Loser! including Battle on the Big Boardwalk and The Fate of Another World, which I think has some of the best parts of the game in them, working on those two extra stories is when the whole team really hit our stride. Going forward, all copies of the game sold will include both these chapters! These chapters have hours of content, and they're just as important to the story as what was in the base game... more importantly, though, I just want everyone to play them! 🙏

Since all copies now include these chapters, we're also retiring the redundant DLC and increasing the price to match the length of the game. I hope everyone enjoys Sam's full adventures meeting Jill on the beach and Emily in another world!

notes.title: Minor bugfix update 1.0.2.73
notes.notes:
​Well... a minor update for y'all, anyway. For us, oh boy, this one represents a lot of work.

This update brings the game in line with the console ports, including various minor rendering issues, a longstanding issue with Autoheal.app, some deeply obscure crashes, and some performance updates that will be trivial on most computers but very large on lower spec hardware. It also enables a new scaling mode for non-1080p high resolution screens that I think should be good enough in most cases. Plus, we finally implemented some voice barks on game start that we always wanted in there but somehow never had time for until now.

If you encounter any bugs, as always, please let me know with an email to support@loveconquersallgames.com right away and I'll look into it!​

notes.title: Get in the Car, Loser! plushie... and console port!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33589193/32c812082ff30c05c8c2c73b8a87482998cf2472.png[/img]

Hey... can you keep a secret? Everyone knows that Sam Anon was the cool goth megababe healer in the party that defeated the Machine Devil, but did you also know her real name is secretly Princess Sam Under Heaven? That's right! The princess herself! She helped keep the party alive and fighting with her support and ravage abilities—who knows what powerful magic you could gain from this trinket of an all new legendary hero? This cute lesbian disaster has famously proven she'll join you on any road trip you tell her to... but getting to spread out her legs and rest at your desk would be nice too.

[hr][/hr]

That's right! We're doing one more plushie in collaboration with Makeship, this one of Sam from Get in the Car, Loser! I've been holding onto the prototype of this one for a bit now and I'm really happy with how she turned out... I wouldn't be making these if I wasn't excited about them too! Man. She's so cute. Look, it's OUR GIRL! ...anyway. The way Makeship works is that they take crowdfunded preorders and only make that many, and they'll need to get 200 orders to make it happen. [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/sam-anon-plush]It'll cost $29.99 and the campaign will be running for all of Pride Month until July 2![/url]

Plus... we've got one more bit of news! This one's huge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33589193/4b657c27aeb65e36e193adec5ddc52f31a8b1eb6.png[/img]

BECAUSE YOU ASKED FOR IT! For basically three years nonstop! The summer road trip adventure is NOW PORTABLE! Coming to the Nintendo Switch™ this September, this special edition includes all four chapters of the battle to fight the Machine Devil, plus the bonus beach DLC Battle on the Big Boardwalk, and the culminating final extra story DLC Fate of Another World! 

I'm really excited about this one, this is my first-ever console release, so I'm a little starstruck that it's actually real!

[url=https://news.loveconquersallgames.com/#/portal/signup/free]If you wanna get an email about it when it comes out, you can sign up for that here![/url]

notes.title: The Fate of Another World is now available!
notes.notes:
[i]MEET YOUR FAVOURITE HERO'S FAVOURITE HERO: Emily Harmless used to be an activist, a librarian, and a scholar... but she had to put that all aside when she was chosen by fate itself as the warrior who must seal away the Machine Devil. Is there any hope for her to find peace in the burning ruins of her world after carrying out the heavens’ mission?[/i]

We've just released our second DLC chapter that picks up the story of Get in the Car, Loser! from right after the final boss fight. Clocking in at 4-6 hours long, it features even more content than one of our normal chapters, two new party members with Emily's unique full-power Sword of Fate super meter, five new enemy types, two new bosses, an all new progression system, a new soundtrack both in battle and on the road... and shocking divine truths.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33589193/132e22d0c4e7b3487fdd475d12e0c83e811c7bea.png[/img]

Over the past year of updating GITCL and working on this new chapter, we've tried to channel everything we've learned into the new battles and mechanics, and I'm really proud of the result—I personally think this one's got some of our most interesting fights yet, and I've put my whole heart into the writing on this one—I'm very excited to share the story of Emily Harmless, Prince Sam, and Jo of the Mountain with you all. You can learn more about The Fate of Another World and your new heroes here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1759520/Get_In_The_Car_Loser__The_Fate_of_Another_World/

notes.title: Feature update 1.0.2.40
notes.notes:
It's hard to believe it's been half a year since the game launched! This is a real big update of things we've wanted to address for a while now.

​[img]https://i.imgur.com/eBfnwBI.png[/img]

First off, the following feature has been added: the BATTLE INVENTORY! Now, instead of a giant unwieldy unsorted list of items in battle, you can pick up to five items that you can select in battle at any time. This also means you'll never have to worry about accidentally using up items you need to heal as upgrade fodder. To compensate for no longer being able to spam 100 knives in a single battle, we've also added the Prayer on the Wind, a special item that gives the whole party a temporary boost that replenishes at the end of each battle. Use items strategically to end battles faster!

​[img]https://i.imgur.com/pxK7i2s.png[/img]

This update also adds another small in-game feature: IN-GAME HELP! Not sure how damage scaling works? Wondering why you can't unlock any new items? Just check the help pages for answers to the most commonly asked questions about GITCL's admittedly unconventional systems!

The following balance changes have been made, especially in Act I:

[list]
[*]Increased diversity of mandatory encounters in Act I, so it's not just the same Wrong Dolphin + Supporter fight repeatedly.
[*]Adjusted the lane filling mechanism in Act I to make it so if you want to do extra fights to gain more money, you'll have to change lanes and go looking for them.
[*]Increased Act I rewards across the board to make slightly fewer fights necessary to keep up with gas costs.
[*]Modified the spoils curve for the entire game, so that you now get rewarded with even more gas points by defeating enemies of a higher rank than yours. 
[/list]
​Finally, the following issues have been addressed:

[list]
[*]Sometimes, the radio interstitial audio wouldn't play between acts. This should be fixed now, but if you encounter an act transition where the radio is silent, please let me know!
[*]A bug where you could press confirm on the DLC act transition and skip dialogue as a result.
[*]Enemies with no spawn animations (ie, bosses and certain miniboss encounters) will have outlines even after the Slow effect wears off.
[*]The game forgets which slot is selected every time you close the save/load screen.
[*]"Rewind to Shrine" plays wrong music in DLC.
[*]Previously, the game would crash if it encountered a persistent save file that was damaged. It will now attempt to recover.
[*]"Death at the Door" would track its progress incorrectly if completed in Act III or later.
[*]Bounty displayed changes on mandatory Devil Clock fights on road when you toggle the optional Devil Clock on and off. (The actual reward was always the same, it was just a display bug.)
[*]Stagger doesn't trigger if you open a selection menu in "WAIT" mode right before the effect should kick in.
[*]Requests can still appear on the road again even if they've already been beaten.
[*]Abilities that target party members could say "UNABLE TO TARGET" if the enemy is untargetable, under some circumstances.
[*]Starting a new game would play the last road music from your play session, not the Act I music.
[*]Under certain obscure circumstances, boost could last beyond a single fight.
[*]Under certain obscure circumstances, the kill flash could persist forever, even after battle.
[*]When checking an attack with multiple elements to see if it should heal or do extra damage, it would check healing first. Now, if you hit an enemy with both its weakness and its own element, the the weakness will take priority.
[*]Various obscure crashes have been fixed.
[/list]
If you encounter any of these issues still, please let me know with an email to support@loveconquersallgames.com right away and I'll look into it!

notes.title: Minor update 1.0.1.34

[list][*]Enemies now have 70% of normal maximum health (compared to 100% in normal, or 150% in Devil Clock mode).
[*]Enemy attack speeds have been, on average, halved.
[*]Rewards for finishing battles have now been doubled.
[*]When starting a new game in Story Mode, battle menus will be automatically set to "wait" mode. If you've already started a game, you can enable or disable this from the options menu at any time.[/list]
No changes have been made to the game outside of Story Mode.​

notes.title: Feature update 1.0.1.33
notes.notes:
This update adds a new feature accessible at any point in the game: the LORE BIBLE, which can be found in the menu to show any road story you've ever unlocked, even if you don't have the item currently in your inventory!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LY167Tj.png[/img]

Additionally, the following issues have been addressed:
[list]
[*]Using "A Knife" in battle could crash if used on a dying enemy.
[*]Xbox Series controllers should now work correctly on macOS.
[*]Holding onto a Zantetsuken charge for the entirety of the fight with Jill could cause an issue when used during the final phase.
[*]Using "try again" during the Machine Devil fight could sometimes not reset the music on certain phases.
[*]Fixed a memory leak involving certain full screen animations.
[*]Expression sprites now interact correctly with the save system. Before, sometimes outfits wouldn't be updated correctly on conversation sprites.
[*]It should not be possible to save in the fake Act III minishrine that appears after the boss warning banner. Previously, there was a way to accidentally get around this check, but it should now be impossible. Please note that if you have a save file in this map, you'll have to reload from an autosave.
[*]Stamps should only become available once you've entered the new area. Before, it was possible to get them in the interstitial between the previous boss fight and the start of the new act.
[*]A rendering error on Erox vines in the DLC chapter has been fixed.
[*]It was possible to crash the game by pausing right before a cutscene during the final boss fight. This has now been fixed.
[*]The continuous splash SFX of Salamanders no longer plays if the game is paused.
[*]You can no longer avoid ending the Taunt Burst's invincibility portion by keeping the taunt timer going indefinitely—the taunt effect will continue, but the invincibility will only last as long as the initial timer. In other words, Val will no longer be immortal if you use Lockdown immediately after Taunt Burst (although it's still a pretty effective strategy).
[*]Devil Clock no longer ticks during story segments.
[*]A visual glitch where opening the menu during a gacha pull would cause the screen to be permanently torn has been fixed.
[*]A rendering error while using Zantetsuken on an enemy while the Devil Clock is visible has been fixed.
[*]A rendering error with images that are part of ability names on items has been fixed.
[*]Field guides are no longer logged.
[*]You can no longer revive a party member during the period between the entire party dying and the Game Over screen appearing.[/list]
If you encounter any of these issues still, please let me know with an email to support@loveconquersallgames.com right away and I'll look into it!

​​This update fixes the following issues:

[list]
[*]If you do a Community Request fight on the road, run away, then immediately try it again and win, it won't flag the battle as completed in the Treasure Bureau. This is now fixed, but please note that if the fix won't come into effect on pre-existing save files until after you've visited a rest stop.
[*]Victory music continues to play on loop indefinitely after loading some save files.
[*]Sam's walk speed was incorrectly bounded and could cause her to zip wildly across the map on certain computers.
[*]Loading a save file while still in the tutorial could cause the Sword of Fate to become unavailable until restart.
[*]If Angela is bleeding while the first boss is killed, it would cause a copy of her to appear in the air for the rest of the fight. Also addressed an issue where certain conditions could cause a crash during this battle.
[*]Party doesn't appear in car after completing Battle on the Big Boardwalk.
[*]Ally select boxes can crash under certain circumstances if open at the end of a battle.
[*]Occasionally the menu screen will crash under unknown conditions related to equipment loadouts. I don't know why, but I've added a failsafe that should catch this regardless.
[*]Possible to softlock the game during the tutorial's rest stop by looking at an item and being unable to close the menu. 
[/list]

​If you encounter any of these issues still, please let me know with an email to support@loveconquersallgames.com right away and I'll look into it!
